Nigeria Supply Chain Senior Coordinator - Logistics & Delivery Job at One Acre Fund




        
    

        
        One Acre, founded in 2006, supplies smallholder farmers with the agricultural services they need to make their farms more productive. We provide quality farm supplies on credit, delivered within walking distance of farmers’ homes, and agricultural trainings to improve harvests. We measure our success by our ability to make farmers more prosperous: On average, farmers harvest 50 percent more food after working with One Acre Fund. We serve more than 800,000 farm families in Eastern and Southern Africa, with more than 7,500 full-time staff, and we aim to serve 1 million farm families by 2020.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Nigeria Supply Chain Senior Coordinator - Logistics & Delivery
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    



Job Location: Minna, Niger
Preferred Start Date: As soon as possible

About the Role


	Lead regional and nationwide last-mile delivery, optimize owned fleet and 3PL capacity, manage warehouse dispatch, and drive cost efficiency.
	Build a reliable, data-driven delivery network that moves inputs to more farmers, on time and in full, at scale.


Responsibilities
Fleet Management & 3PL Logistics:


	Lead regional and nationwide last-mile delivery operations, optimizing owned fleet efficiency and managing strategic 3PL transport partner relationships.


Logistics Optimization & Warehouse Dispatch:


	Oversee daily warehouse dispatch operations, execute route planning, and improve logistics workflows to ensure inputs reach farmers on time and in full.


Data-Driven Performance & Spend Analysis:


	Utilize logistics metrics and transport data to track performance gaps, optimize transport spend, and drive cost efficiencies across regional distribution networks.


Cross-Functional Team Leadership:


	Direct and develop the logistics team while collaborating closely with Warehouse Operations, Procurement, and QA/QC units to align field logistics goals.


Qualifications
Across all roles, these are the general qualifications we look for. For this role specifically, you will have:


	Bachelor's Degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Procurement, or a related field.   
	3+ years of experience in fleet management, last-mile delivery, and managing 3PL logistics networks.   
	Proven track record in warehouse dispatch management, route planning, and driving on-time, in-full (OTIF) delivery efficiencies.   
	Strong analytical and data ability to evaluate transport spend, analyze performance gaps, and make data-driven logistics decisions.   
	Demonstrated leadership capability to manage, mentor, and build high-performing logistics teams.   
	Excellent cross-functional coordination skills to collaborate with Warehouse Operations, HSE/QA/QC, and Procurement teams.

Digital Marketing Specialist Job at Zithelo Real Estate




        
    

        
        Zithelo is an urban development and real estate investment company focused on delivering well-structured, high-quality developments within prime city locations — combining functionality, contemporary design, and long-term investment value.

We develop connected spaces for modern professionals, remote workers, and diaspora investors — built with fibre optic infrastructure and structured investment models that generate strong rental income and long-term capital growth.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Digital Marketing Specialist

Job Location: Lagos, Nigeria

Requirements
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	Candidates should possess relevant qualifications with a minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience.
	Practical digital marketing experience
	Strong communication and creative skills
	Knowledge of online advertising and lead generation, and a portfolio of previous work.


Who should apply:


	We seek a creative, results-oriented professional who can.
	Manage social media platforms and brand pres- ence.
	Create engaging graphics, videos, captions, and campaigns.
	Plan and execute digital advertising strategies.
	Generate leads and support sales conversion.
	Analyse campaign performance and improve re- sults.
	Apply SEO and content marketing strategies.


What You Can Gain


	Competitive Compensation based on your skills and experience.
	Career Growth in a dynamic real estate environment.
	Creative Freedom to develop inno- vative campaigns.
	Professional Development and the opportunity to drive measurable business results.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Note: For more information Call: +234 813 483 4887.

We are committed to forging long-term partnerships with our clients by creating and delivering robust and flexible services that address the changing needs of their business.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Logistics Officer

Job Location: Sagamu, Ogun
Employment Type: Full-time
Department: Logistics

Job Summary
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	We are seeking an experienced and proactive Logistics Officer to manage daily logistics and transportation operations.
	The successful candidate will coordinate deliveries, transporters, and suppliers while ensuring timely, cost-effective, and compliant movement of goods.


Key Responsibilities


	Coordinate inbound and outbound deliveries and transportation activities.
	Liaise with transporters, suppliers, and other logistics partners.
	Prepare logistics reports and maintain accurate documentation.
	Monitor delivery schedules to ensure timely and efficient distribution.
	Track logistics costs and identify opportunities for cost reduction.
	Support inventory and transportation management processes.
	Ensure compliance with company policies, safety standards, and logistics procedures.
	Resolve delivery and transportation issues promptly.


Requirements


	HND / B.Sc. Degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
	Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience in logistics or transportation.
	Fresh graduates are not eligible.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and SAP is required.
	Good knowledge of inventory and transportation management.
	Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
	Ability to coordinate multiple logistics activities effectively.


Salary
N120,000 - N180,000 monthly.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using “Logistics Officer” as subject of the mail.
